_what: Three candidate 8-premise sets for MACRO_GENERATOR_V0_1 round 4, as silhouette-drawing params. Row A is the eight round-3 plans (MAPGEN_PAINTER_V1_1 round 3, 2026-09-09, seeds 1-8 on deep_desert.md) drawn literally: through-channels at the plan's orientation, anchor at the plan's cell_frac. Rows B and C are proposals. Doc: ../map_generator_round4_options.md

rows.title: topology-shape chooser: one shape class per map, no two alike

premises.premise: The cut is the only road: one canyon corner to corner, held at the narrows.
A box canyon walks in from the south and stops; its head is the deepest shade on the map.
Half the map is a table above the other half; the one cliff between them is the whole geography.
A cliff wall crosses the map; the one breach in it is the only door.
One throat swallows the middle of the map; the only living ground is the floor of the pit.
A wreck fell and made the ring; the low gap in the rim is the only way in.
One rock in nothing; its shadow is the only shade and the only reason to stop.
A wide trench runs the map; the shoulder above it is the one high ground.

rows.title: the corpus premises transposed into deep-desert vocabulary (ceiling test)

premises.premise: A dead river braids in from the north and dies in the salt basin it once filled.
One rock stands in a wide gap, and the halt in its shade is empty.
Every green thing on the map hugs one brine line down the canyon floor.
A tongue of plateau pushes into the sand; the only shelter is the cove in its lee.
One red gulch cuts the map corner to corner; the only way across is the narrows.
A rockfall dammed the canyon; the dry reservoir behind it is a salt pan.
Something fell out of the west and the ring it made is the only shade; the debris ray points home.
The whole map is the floor of one sinkhole; the plain is a rim you only see from below.
